title: Two Annas a Ride: Dharampal Gulati's Tonga Before the Spice Shop
conflicts: Tonga duration: 'a few days' (Business Today and Weekend Leader, from MDH's bio-sketch) versus carriage sold in October 1948 (PTI in The Tribune, citing the same bio-sketch); the story gives no duration. First shop: 14x9 ft khokha on Ajmal Khan Road (company account) versus 'small wooden roadside shop' (Ahluwalia); both compatible and used. An unconfirmed Khajoor Road plot was not used.
notes: The episode runs from the 27 September 1947 arrival to the reopening of the family trade; dated 1947 though the shop opening may fall in 1948. Gulati's only quotation comes from Mallika Ahluwalia's interview-based book as excerpted by PTI (The News Minute). MDH's own website did not load.
